p: father: He speaks this as a preacher and minister which is as a father to the people, Pr 2:8.
taught me also: Meaning, David his father.

Wisdom is the principal thing: He shows that we must first begin with God's word, if we will that other things prosper with us, contrary to the judgment of the world, which make it their last study, or else care not for it at all.
taught thee in the way of: Solomon declares what care his father had to bring him up in the true fear of God: for this was David's protest.
straitened: You will walk at liberty without offence.
sleep not: Meaning that to do evil is more proper and natural to the wicked than to sleep, eat or drink.
wickedness: Gotten my wicked means and cruel oppression.
shineth more and more unto the: Signifying that the godly increase daily in knowledge and perfection, till they come to full persecution, which is when the are joined to their head in the heavens.
flesh: That is, they will have health of body: under which all other blessings promised in the law are contained.
life: For as the heart is either pure or corrupt, so is the whole course of man's life.
Ponder the path of thy feet: Keep a measure in all your doings.
